title: Rethinking Nature in Contemporary Japan
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: This volume builds on the international conference of the same title held at Ca’ Foscari University of Venice in 2013 with the support of the Japan Foundation, which discussed the earthquake, tsunami and nuclear accident of 11th March 2011 in northeastern Japan. The papers bring together research in the fields of political science, international relations, sociology and anthropology to offer a multidimensional perspective on the complex issues relating to the triple disaster of 3/11 and its aftermath.
